 1. Preflight
    ok: root, Incus 6.0.5, the gateway container runs, routes in /etc/dokploy/traefik/dynamic/devbox.yml, firewall: none
 2. Secrets
    + write /etc/devbox/secrets.toml: wake password hash, cookie secret, gateway↔hub token (mode 0600, owner 65532)
 3. Incus instance
    + create devbox: images:ubuntu/26.04/cloud, 3 CPU, 5GiB memory, 60GiB disk, 10.77.0.10 on incusbr0, memory saved on sleep (6GiB of disk), not started with the host, user dev with 1 SSH key(s)
 4. Provision the VM
    + install as dev in devbox: base packages, code-server on :8080, claude, codex, opencode, devbox-hub and devbox (the latest release of prabhask5/devbox), their services, agent hooks, the hub's config and secrets
 5. Dotfiles
    none given: pass --dotfiles <git url> to bring your shell, editor and agent setup
 6. Host config
    + write /etc/devbox/devbox.toml: code.example.com → devbox (10.77.0.10)
 7. Routing
    + write /etc/dokploy/traefik/dynamic/devbox.yml: code.example.com and agents.example.com → http://devbox-gateway:8080
 8. Firewall
    left to you: allow tcp from 172.16.0.0/12 to 10.77.0.10 ports 22,8080,8090, and nothing else to the VM
 9. Monitor
    the health URL for a monitor is https://code.example.com/__devbox/health
10. Verify
    ask https://code.example.com/__devbox/health through the public path, as a browser would

4 changes.
